multi_replica_smoke.placement: same-node temporary second backend on host port 8001

review_fix.issue: The original Hermes session migration omitted database defaults for non-null timestamps, causing session creation to return HTTP 500 on PostgreSQL.
review_fix.resolution: Migration 20260914_0074 adds now() defaults to created_at and updated_at; a migration regression test was added.

boundaries: The temporary second backend validates shared PostgreSQL session consistency between two application processes.
Both instances ran on one K3s node, so this evidence does not satisfy multi-node fault-domain, P4, or P9 acceptance.
The target could not reach Debian package mirrors; the exact source was layered on the previously verified backend image without changing dependencies.
